text: Watch, wonder, build, and tear down, Nerevar.

It is has been so very long since we last met, Nerevar. It is a great shame that you did not keep your hair, for I recall it was quite the conversation piece. Ah, but that isn't relevant now. We have met to discuss larger matters, for I hear you wish to reach Sotha Sil.
Salutations, traveler! I welcome you to the Garden of Akatosh.
So the look-alike has arived. You invade my homeland and murder my vassals and liegemer. I am Indoril Nerevar Mora, Hortator and ruler of Resdaynia, and by my ancestors you shall not escape alive!
Another one? Come to make fun of poor Salms for daring to speak his mind?
Stay back, stay back! You have metal on you, I'm sure of it!
Keeping out of the shrubs, I hope? They took a long time to engineer.

What are you doing in here? You're not here to take away my experiments, are you? Or worse, walk around in my conductor shrubs? I cannot allow that, so if you are I-
You're not here to walk around and ruin my shrubs? Oh dear, I've made a fool of myself. I suppose it was inevitable; I get far too absorbed in my work.

My lord bids me to stop your intrusion, and so I shall. You have bested his advisers, and seek now to murder the Hortator. I am Serjo Indoril's champion and his most faithful vassal, Voryn Dagoth, and you will never meet him on the field of combat but through me.
So. You've killed the clown with pretensions of power. I am the Face-Snaked Queen of the Three-in-One, and you'll not find me so easy to best.
Do you know me by my names, outlander? I am the demon-god of the star-wounded east, Vehk and Vehk, the martial axiom. You will die by a thousand cuts unseen, for I am lord of the middle air.
I've not seen you before. You new in Sotha Sil? Well, welcome, we're all friendly here, sera.
A visitor! I've never seen one! Is it true you breathe fire and have plants in place of your mechanisms?
I don't know you, do you need something?
If I haven't said it before, welcome to Sotha Sil.
How do you like our city, %PCRace? It can be much more confusing than the cities from your world.
In these troubled times, I feel like I need a drink. Though, I suppose, welcome to Sotha Sil; it's usually in better shape than this.
While I have nothing personal against you, let me say from the start that you'll do more harm than good to Sotha Sil. We have enough problems as it is.
Watch where you step in Sotha Sil, %PCRace; the city is always full of surprises.
We're all devout here in Sotha Sil, friend.
Greetings, %PCRace.

The winds have whispered to me, %PCName. They have told me of your failure to enter Hrothmund's Barrow. In order to become chieftain of Thirsk, you needed to enter the barrow and grasp the axe of Hrothmund to receive his blessing. Now, that will never happen. This is a sad day. I fear Thirsk will never reopen.
Might want to get your mechanisms checked, you sound sick.
You seem a bit sickly, you're not broken, are you?
You've got the corprus! There's no cure for that, is there?
Ah, welcome back, %PCName. How has your time in Sotha Sil treated you?
Enjoying the city, %PCName?
Watch, Wonder, Build, and Tear Down, %PCName
Greetings, %PCRace
It is a fine hour indeed, %PCRace. How are you?
May your clock tick well into the future, %PCName.
Hail, muthsera. May your gears turn ever onward.
Hello, %PCRace. It is an honor.
I do believe we have met before. Welcome, %PCRace.
You are always welcome here, %PCName.
Watch, Wonder, Build, and Tear Down, %PCName.
Greetings, %PCRace.
Hello, %PCRace.
Welcome, %PCRace. If you break any of things, I'll call the watch.
%PCname.
I wonder if... no, no. Oh, hello, %PCName
Do you have business here, %PCRace?
Very well, %PCRace, I shall listen.
Can I help you?
I shall lend an arm or two to you for a moment, %PCRace.
Just make it quick, %PCRace, I have a lot of work to do.
Touch anything and I'll call the Watch.
You have my ear, %PCRace, use it well.
Very well, though I won't like it.
Consider me interested, though not by your wonderful personality.
You're starting to grind my gears a bit, so make it quick.

Pardon me, I'm busy.
But I suppose I have no choice. I shall listen.
Go ahead.
Greetings, %PCRace.
No. Whatever it is, no.
Pardon me, but there's a very strange man in my house, and he won't leave. Will you go get him out of there, please?
With an outfit like that, you must be doing very well for yourself. Can I help you?
I do not rise to petty insults.
Only the winds of death blow from the lips of mortals.
I want you to take a good hard look at me, and ask yourself: Was this a good idea?
What use does a spirit have for gold?
(He motions to his neck.)

The name's Kummuuuu, I run this here emporium. To be more accurate, it's more like a garbage dump. That lift up there and that pit over there leads to the lower levels, where I dredge up anything I can find. I do get some good things, equipment, automatons, and torches.
I have far too many torches.
I... am... Hahnab-222. This... vessel... holds... my mind. It... allows... me.... to... speak... where... otherwise... I... would... not. He... is... willing... and... I... treat... him... well.
Oh me, you know who I am, because you're me. Everything is. Just my dream. Just like everything.
Up and down and up and down and can't talk stacking shut up shut up shut up. Yabin-721 is stacking, chairs on chairs, be quiet.

We are the hivemind, Thovum-3. We were born with one soul, but three bodies share it. We have no evil plans. We are not dangerous. Please do not hurt us. We are being completely serious. We have been chased from life to life, because of our abilities.
Sotha Sil Sathgeli at your service, and let me tell you for today only I have the exact wares that YOU need.
*Psssssssssssssssssssssssssshhhhhhhh* *Clunk*

I don't actually know. Everything has been falling for so long. Just endless falling. And the feeling of falling. It's not so bad actually, once you realize you'll never hit the ground you really just learn to live with it.
Haleneri-911. I'm an invalid at the moment, and highly contagious. It seems every week I've got some new disease! It's horrible being as sick as I am.
Wanting to get a little more personal, huh? Oh, I like that. Well, sweetheart, my name is Innuo-101, and I can show you a thing or two about limb removal.

Ullazali-20, little wanderer, and yes, I'm aware I've got a little problem. But blood is just so... enticing. The way it flows from a body, the the way it collects in my little bottles. All the little colors it can be. Oh my. And then there's the blood of gods, from ebony to aetherium to quartz. Beautiful.

Hm. Oh you know who I am! Everyone does! I am Sotha Sil, the god of clockwork. I think?
Or maybe I dressed as him for a party. Or perhaps Sotha Sil dressed as Goveri-999 for that party. And that's me. I wonder if he acknowledged my costume...

They call me the old man. And by 'they' I refer to the walkers in sense, not the small eyed doves that eat moths every friday. If I have a name, I forgot it. Or, it is lost to the annals of baking. It probably had quite a few numbers in it. Everyone's names seem to have those these days.

Merely call me Lord Favthali. I'm not really a lord, but I suppose when one has researched fabricant undead as much as I have, one gets an honorary title. And yes, I am a lich, don't try to kill me you silly adventurer.
Well, if I am what I eat, then I'm everything! Hah! But my name is Devarthi-876. I eat things.
Selethi-01, as you will already know. Fabricant unfortune teller, and seer of the future, though not the past. I remember what will happen, and can only guess on what has happened.
Nagalan-500, in-depth farmer, speaker of fabricants. They say you're probably an adventurer, and I'd believe them if I were you. The stock is usually right about these things.
Talissss-42. I'm not really usssssed to being ssssocial, mosssstly becaussse of my condition, but converssssation is well appreciated.

A pleasure, a pleasure! I am Guidan. Or one of four Guidan. We're two pairs you see, all brothers, all in the same business. If you find yourself in anywhere but the Slums or Hub, feel free to find us!

Alpharius-1, firstborn of the firstborn, though, I must admit, not the first born here in the city. Merely the firstborn. Confused? My apologies. Perhaps a simpler tongue? I am the first son of the High Foremer and the Archcanon, a pure fabricant, born of matrix-rending and nursed in molten steel. Dramatic, but true. These houses are as old as the clockmarrow that ticks through me.
Just a happily married fabricant, sera! And I hope to keep it that way, if you understand.
Uh, Venluen-21? That's who I am.
Ah, how rude of me. I forget myself. I am Kthardz Hrk-zet, at your service.
Abahman-7643, fisherman and sailor. I've been sailing this ocean for years with not an end in sight! But still I persist. What are we without hope, after all?
I am a statue, so I can't talk. Forget this conversation.
I am Ashzastzati, and not some pathetic body made of metal! I damn the wizard who thought himself clever enough to trap my soul, and use it to power this machine.
Alcolan-784, with his belly full 'o spirits and his spirits high on belly spirits or something. Yeah. I'm drunk on my own booze.
I am Nelos-11. And I am Nelos-12. We're a fabricant, singular. And trust me, neither he, nor I, like it very much.

Sunburned. You've heard of that? Happens to fair skinned people. Heard there's dunmer out there with skin black as night. All because of the sun.
Anyways. I get sunburned. I don't peel or hurt though. See, we're made of metal. Hot metal just gets hotter. Hot enough metal melts things. That's what I do. Melt things.
Transicant.

I am one of Seht's earlier Transicants, a relic of a time when he was known by that name still. It is a pity that you did not know him in the full flush of his divinity. His mind shone more brilliantly than Magnus itself, and he could fathom all the depths of the ocean.

My name is irrelevant, as are my origins. Merely know that I was a follower of Sotha Sil, perhaps one of his greatest students in fact. To him, I became a treasure, an ally, and upon my would-be-death, a test. I am the first fabricant, though, if we are to use the proper terminology, I am a transicant. I am the Archcanon, ruler of this city-in-a-city, and the final word on religious matters.

Salms-6, former shopkeeper's assistant, reduced to begging in the street. And here I thought this city was so understanding. Bah. I stand by what I say, only a fool likes gears, sprockets are for the wise and educated.
They used to call me Maggothe-37, though my name is now meaningless, like so much else. I've become a freak, I'm become far too attractive! My life, my dreams, all pointless.

Golamus-15, and my matrix number is... Well it isn't really important is it? My neighbors call me "The Mad Plant Wizard" though I suspect they're jealous; everyone is after a while! And there is so much to be jealous of.
I am %name, I serve Almalexia as one of Her Hands.

Yes! To metal! Wherever I go, metal flies at me, sticks to me, and won't leave me be! And in this city, there is metal everywhere! Entire houses bend to me as I walk down a street, my lover had to have her arms removed, just to escape me! I'm a freak, a walking disaster! Please, I beg you, if by death or by miracle, give me a way to be free of this horrible curse.
I have heard of your success in the Industrial District. You should not hold any ill will towards the Overclockers though. All fabricants desire to experiment, for their curiosity is their curse.
The broken repaired.
Devout but foolish in the generators. Dangerous. Unstable. Stop them. No time. Go. The way is open.

Home to the shops and foundries of our great city. Always busy, and like many busy things, it takes quite a bit of energy. So it is worrisome than the once ever-working Industrial District has now found itself the victim of power outages. Speak to the High Foremer, for they make their home there, and discover the source of these power fluctuations. If you were to stop them, the machines of that district would function properly. Speak to my counterpart in the Industrial District, the High Foremer, about it.

cell_filter: Sotha Sil, Clockwork City, Industrial District
text: Now the two main attractions are the Offices of the High Foremer, which is that building in the center of the district, the one with the two smokestacks. The Foremer is almost always busy, but if you have official business or a breeding request, they'll listen. Finally, the two big buildings connected by the pipeline are the headquarters of the Overclockers, the local engineering-mystic faction. They offer enchanting and augmentation services to those who can afford it.

cell_filter: Sotha Sil, Clockwork City, Industrial District
text: The first, of course, are your basic services. The local smith can be found behind the foundry sector, on the southeast side of the district, the apothecary is the large building in the northeast corner, and the clothier sits on the northwest corner, near the High Foremer's Offices. The big building with all the pipes is the local tavern, the Gear and Sprocket. Good drinks if you're thirsty. Cheap too.

cell_filter: Sotha Sil, Clockwork City, Industrial District
text: This, friend, is the Industrial District. Fabricants are natural experimenters, and so this part of the city exists to give those who work in experiment groups space! Many foundries and bays are found here, where fabricants are employed or otherwise work. There are several points of interest for a visitor to the city; let me go over them.

The Industrial District is where the larger bays for group projects are kept; experiments or constructions too big for any one fabricant to complete on his own. It's filled with laboratories, workshops, and shops for all the things necessary to keep the district afloat. Alchemical reagents, equipment, and so forth. You'll also find offices of the High Foremer there.
We transicants are rare, as such an honor must be undertaken only by the Clockwork God himself. I was one of his greatest students, and now, I am one of his greatest assets.

There are more than just created mer-machines in this city, Nerevar. While the will of the Foremer and the unseen hands of the Regent are the mother and midwife of most of the populous, there are many other types of creations that live in this city. There are replicants, Intelligences, the Angry Bones, and myself, a transicant. I am a normal mer, born under normal circumstances, whose body and mind were taken into an incredible machine, and thus, am no longer mortal.

When useful, they are beautiful, when not, they are horrible. Replicants are mechanical copies of an individual, often of significance to Sotha Sil, such as a lover, an advisor, or a friend. They are built often to guide us, but once they serve their purpose, they are most often discarded, for a copy of something that is not that something can often become dangerous. I have heard you yourself have encountered several of these rogue replicants, down in the depths of the experiment.
